project.title: Rock & Load: Expanded Reclaimer Arsenal
project.project_type: gameplay mod concept; playable implementation not yet built
project.supported_party_size_target: 1-4 players (game's native range; mod replication still requires testing)
project.first_minute: Choose one of the added Reclaimer weapons in the loadout, enter the first cave encounter, and test its primary and alternate fire against the opening enemy group.
project.scope_v1: 12 original Reclaimer weapon concepts across ballistic, industrial, elemental, and energy families.
project.design_status: concept sheet; numeric balance and game hooks intentionally left unverified
project.source_of_truth: This file is the concept source of truth. Change it before implementation when a design decision changes.

weapons.name: Arc Conductor
weapons.primary_fire: A sustained electrical bolt that jumps between nearby enemies after a hit.
weapons.alternate_fire: Discharge the capacitor in a short-range pulse; the pulse consumes stored charge and briefly overloads connected targets.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Strong against clustered enemies; weaker against isolated targets and requires charge management.
weapons.visual_identity: Industrial coil assembly, insulated grips, exposed copper busbars, blue-white arcs.
weapons.audio_identity: Rising transformer hum followed by sharp electrical snaps.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Cryo Needle
weapons.role: precision freeze / setup for team damage
weapons.primary_fire: Fire narrow cryogenic darts that build frost on a single target.
weapons.alternate_fire: Spend accumulated pressure for a piercing ice shard that deals bonus damage to frozen targets.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Rewards accurate follow-up shots; less effective when spraying into a crowd.
weapons.visual_identity: Compact pressure rifle with a frost reservoir, insulated barrel jacket, and pale cyan vents.
weapons.audio_identity: Pneumatic hiss, brittle ice crack, low pressure release.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Rail Splitter
weapons.primary_fire: Charge and launch a dense slug that pierces a line of enemies.
weapons.alternate_fire: A quick low-charge shot with reduced penetration for emergency close-range use.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: High impact and line penetration in exchange for deliberate charge timing and scarce ammunition.
weapons.visual_identity: Long magnetic rails, warning markings, heavy rear capacitor, recoil braces.
weapons.audio_identity: Capacitor whine followed by a sharp metallic rail report.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Rotary Shredder
weapons.primary_fire: A belt-fed rotary cannon with a spin-up and sustained firing cycle.
weapons.alternate_fire: Lock the barrel assembly in an overdrive mode for higher output while rapidly building heat.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Dominates sustained engagements but is heavy, loud, and vulnerable during spin-up or cooling.
weapons.visual_identity: Oversized rotary barrel cluster, feed belt, heat fins, chunky mining-grade housing.
weapons.audio_identity: Mechanical spin-up, deep cyclic gunfire, cooling ticks.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Rivet Storm
weapons.primary_fire: Launch short bursts of heavy rivets that lodge in enemies or cave surfaces.
weapons.alternate_fire: Trigger lodged rivets to detonate in a small controlled burst.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Excellent when the player plans a burst sequence; weaker when forced to reposition constantly.
weapons.visual_identity: Pneumatic piston block, pressure gauge, rivet hopper, scratched yellow safety panels.
weapons.audio_identity: Air compressor thump, rapid metal impacts, compact detonation.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Acid Injector
weapons.primary_fire: Inject a corrosive needle into a target, applying a focused armor-corrosion effect over time.
weapons.alternate_fire: Release a short fan of smaller needles to spread a weaker corrosion effect across several targets.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Improves the whole team's damage against durable targets but has modest immediate burst damage.
weapons.visual_identity: Sealed chemical canister, reinforced injection chamber, hazard labels, green pressure windows.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Magnetar Disc
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a spinning magnetic disc that ricochets between enemies and returns to the wielder.
weapons.alternate_fire: Recall the disc early to alter its return path and strike enemies again.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Can hit several targets on a planned path, but misses and poor positioning waste the throw window.
weapons.visual_identity: Thick steel disc, magnetic rim, warning LEDs, rugged wrist-mounted return receiver.
weapons.audio_identity: High-pitched spin, metallic ricochets, magnetic catch clack.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Seismic Projector
weapons.primary_fire: Emit a forward ground-hugging shockwave that staggers enemies in a cone.
weapons.alternate_fire: Compress the wave into a narrow, longer-reaching impact line with less width.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Creates breathing room for the squad but loses effectiveness at long range and against stagger-resistant targets.
weapons.visual_identity: Twin counter-rotating impact drums, reinforced muzzle plates, vibration dampers.
weapons.audio_identity: Low concussive thump with a rattling mechanical tail.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Gravity Well Launcher
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a slow gravitic charge that creates a brief pull field, drawing nearby small enemies toward its center.
weapons.alternate_fire: Manually collapse the field early in a compact implosion.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Sets up team area damage and interrupts movement, but deals limited direct damage before collapse.
weapons.visual_identity: Heavy containment cage, floating inner core, gravity warning dials, violet distortion lens.
weapons.audio_identity: Deep spatial hum, rising pressure tone, muted implosion.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Thermal Lance
weapons.primary_fire: Project a continuous heat beam that builds temperature on the target and progressively weakens armor.
weapons.alternate_fire: Vent accumulated heat in a short forward flare, forcing a cooldown before the beam can resume.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Rewards tracking one priority target; overheating interrupts sustained damage.
weapons.visual_identity: Industrial beam emitter, ceramic cooling collars, bright amber core, heavy heat sinks.
weapons.audio_identity: Steady electrical whine that rises with heat, then a sharp vent hiss.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Magma Mortar
weapons.primary_fire: Lob a slow thermal shell that bursts on impact and leaves a brief hot zone.
weapons.alternate_fire: Compress the payload into a direct-impact slug with a smaller blast and stronger single-target hit.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Controls chokepoints and groups of enemies but has a slow projectile and limited ammunition.
weapons.visual_identity: Short-barrel pressure mortar, ceramic shell rack, heat-shielded grips, orange vents.
weapons.audio_identity: Heavy launch thump, molten splash, cooling crackle.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

weapons.name: Bore-Drill Cannon
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a powered drill head that bores through a line of enemies before losing momentum.
weapons.alternate_fire: Reverse the drill head early, pulling it back through the same corridor for a second pass.
weapons.signature_tradeoff: Rewards lining up targets and controlling corridors; performs poorly when enemies surround the player.
weapons.visual_identity: Oversized mining drill cartridge, exposed drive gears, hydraulic braces, striped hazard shell.
weapons.audio_identity: Hydraulic kick, aggressive drilling grind, reverse motor whirr.
weapons.numeric_balance: unverified against the current weapon roster

verified_game_facts: A mission starts with choosing a Phase Suit and Reclaimer Weapon.
Weapons and equipment can be salvaged during stages.
Community Blueprint mods and .pak-based mod loading exist for Rogue Core.
